title: Antennas
description: A list of antenna master data variants (attack pattern / level-evolution stages) for a single antenna id, parsed into Anntena (lib/domain/master_data/anntena.dart). One file per antenna, under assets/data/antennas/attack|support|other/, each containing an array with one entry per selectable variant.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by other data and code, and looked up in the app's localization resources for display text.

category.description: Which selection-dialog tab this variant is grouped under.

targetCount.description: Number of targets this antenna's move hits, or null/omitted if it hits every opposing target instead of a fixed count.

dealsDamage.description: Whether this antenna's move deals damage. Defaults to false.

attackAttributeId.description: Attribute id (see attributes.json) of the damage this antenna deals, or null/omitted if it deals no attribute-typed damage.

isInheritable.description: Whether this antenna can be inherited (bred) onto offspring. Defaults to false.

evolvesToId.description: Antenna id this one evolves into, or null/omitted if it has no evolution.

maxLevel.description: Highest level (shown as a "+N" suffix in-game) this variant's name applies through before evolving via evolvesToId, or null/omitted if it doesn't level-evolve.

variantGroupId.description: Groups this variant together with its sibling target-pattern variants (e.g. 1-target/3-target/all-target of the same base move), selectable via a separate pattern slider in the selection dialog. Null/omitted if this antenna has only one pattern.
